questions.q: How many settlements did the guys decide to visit?
questions.e: In the video: "Obilazimo deset naselja sa najčudnijim imenima" — we're visiting ten settlements with the strangest names.

questions.q: What do they do in each village?
o: Stick a sticker on the sign and take a photo
Film the village with a drone
questions.e: In the video: "Lepimo nalepnicu i slikamo se ispred znaka" — we stick a sticker and take a photo in front of the sign.

questions.q: Who is Kepawoz?
o: A resident of the village of Mozgovo
A YouTuber from Kruševac who drew the stickers
questions.e: In the video: "Ovo je Kepawoz, jutjuber iz Kruševca" — the author asked him to draw the stickers.

questions.q: Why is David behind the wheel?
o: He's the only one who can drive
questions.e: In the video: "Budući da je ovo Davidova ideja, on vozi" — since this is David's idea, he drives.

questions.q: Where are most of the villages on the list located?
questions.e: In the video: "Skontao sam da su skoro sva sela na jugu Srbije" — I figured out that almost all the villages are in the south of Serbia.

questions.q: Why did the guys regret what they had thought about the shop?
o: The shop assistant turned out to be very nice and friendly
The shop turned out to be closed
questions.e: In the video: "Žena koja radi je bila toliko fina i ljubazna da smo se odmah pokajali" — the woman who works there was so nice and kind that we immediately felt sorry.

questions.q: What happened to the car on the way?
o: It got stuck in the mud
questions.e: In the video: "Auto nam se malo pregrejao. Krenula je voda u hladnjaku da kipi" — our car overheated a little. The water in the radiator started to boil.

questions.q: Why couldn't the "Dupci" sticker be put up at first?
o: The navigator led uphill, where there was neither a road nor a sign
questions.e: In the video: "Google mape su nas vodile u brdo. Niti ima znaka, niti ima puta" — Google Maps led us up a hill. There's neither a sign nor a road.

questions.q: Why did the "Kurići" sticker end up on the sign of another village?
o: Kurići is part of a village and has no sign of its own
questions.e: In the video: "Kurići su samo neko naselje pored sela Korlače" — it's part of another village, with no sign of its own. The sticker was put on the Piskanje sign.

questions.q: Why were the last two villages filmed with a lamp?
o: By the time they arrived, it had already gotten dark
questions.e: In the video: "Malo pada mrak, tako da preostala dva sela ćemo snimiti po mraku" — it's getting a bit dark, so we'll film the remaining two villages in the dark.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Sada lepimo *nalepnicu* i slikamo se ispred znaka.
questions.e: Nalepnica — a sticker, from the verb lepiti "to stick".

questions.q: Skontao sam da su *skoro* sva sela na jugu Srbije.
questions.e: False friend: skoro means "almost", not "soon". "Soon" in Serbian is uskoro.

questions.q: Na putu do sledećeg sela smo malo *ogladneli*.
questions.e: Ogladneti — to get hungry, from gladan "hungry".

questions.q: Svratili smo u *najjeziviju* prodavnicu koju smo ikada videli.
questions.e: Jeziv — creepy, from jeza "a shiver, a chill". The prefix naj- gives the superlative.

questions.q: Odmah smo se pokajali zbog takvog *mišljenja*.
questions.e: False friend: mišljenje means "opinion", not "thinking". From misliti "to think, to consider".

questions.q: Auto nam se malo *pregrejao*.
questions.e: Pregrejati se — to overheat: pre- "over-" and grejati "to heat".

questions.q: Nakon sat i po puta, *konačno* smo stigli.
questions.e: False friend: konačno means "finally", not "of course". "Of course" in Serbian is naravno.

questions.q: Ovamo levo je *skretanje* za selo Dupci.
questions.e: Skretanje — a turn, from skrenuti "to turn".

questions.q: Ovde David i ja pripadamo jer smo *pametni*.
questions.e: False friend: pametan means "smart", not "memorable". Pamet means "intellect".

questions.q: Pa smo *odustali* i krenuli ka narednom selu.
questions.e: Odustati — to give up on something planned, to surrender. Don't confuse it with ostati "to stay".

questions.q: Konjino je jedno od naselja sa najsmešnijim ___ u Srbiji.
questions.e: After sa ("with") the instrumental case is needed. For ime in the plural it is imenima.

questions.q: Cela Srbija je puna ___ sa glupim imenima.
questions.e: Pun ("full of something") requires the genitive case. The plural of selo is sela.

questions.q: Ovo je jutjuber koji je stajao sa ___ u Trouglu.
questions.e: After sa the instrumental case is needed: ja → mnom. Sa mnom — "with me".

questions.q: Skoro sva sela su na ___ Srbije.
questions.e: The question "where?" is answered by na with the locative case: jug → na jugu.

questions.q: Krenuli smo dalje, spremni da skejtujemo u ___.
questions.e: "Where?" — u with the locative case: u Kruševcu (the fleeting a drops out). U Kruševac would be "where to?".

questions.q: Skontao sam da smo prošli pored ___.
questions.e: Pored ("past, next to") requires the genitive case: on → njega.

questions.q: Slikamo se ___ svakog natpisa na ulazu.
questions.e: Ispred — "in front of": they are photographed in front of the sign. Iza — "behind", između — "between", preko — "across".

questions.q: Prvo selo je udaljeno samo 30 km ___ našeg grada.
questions.e: Udaljen od — "distant from", followed by the genitive case. Do would be "up to": 30 km do grada.

questions.q: Očekujem da mu se zahvalite ___ ove nalepnice.
questions.e: Zahvaliti se za — "to thank for", followed by the accusative case.

questions.q: Preostala dva sela ćemo snimiti ___ mraku.
questions.e: Po mraku — "in the dark": a fixed expression, po with the locative case.
